description: Queue one immediate run of a database schedule. Refused while the schedule is disabled or a run is already queued. Destructive: the statements execute against the database; requires confirmed: true. If the answer is lost, read database_schedule_run_list before calling again; a second call queues another run. Refused with project_budget_exceeded while the project's Stop budget is reached.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: database_schedule_run_now
